3.6: Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under:Assessed Available Tender Capacity: (AxNx2.5-B)Where A-Maximum value of works executed (KPTCL & Non-KPTCL) in any one year during the last five years (updated to FY 2024-2025) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.

3.7: Even though the Tenderers meet the above criteria, they are subject to be disqualified if they have:- Made misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and/or- Record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history, or financial failures etc. and/or- Participated in the previous Tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high Tender prices and could not furnish rational justification.

Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) of the bidder for best two years out of last preceding five financial years ending on March or December as the case may be, shall not be less than Amount put to Tender (APT) as per 3.2(a) of std tender documents(ITT).

Earth mat formation:
Supplying and Grounding of Equipment with G.I.Flat 50X6mm  and connecting Equipment to the earth mat/ground pit.  Each point of earthing with all formation works like bending, twisting, drilling of holes and connecting by welding (inclusive of T&P and consumables) to the earthmat/Groundpit/point of earth connection.

Moving of Transformer from the plinth to the loading point as per direction of site Engineer.
48.95Mtx50mtrs x 2no.=4895
Releasing of RTCC panel
Releasing of 800-1200/1-1A NCT
Releasing of wiring 1*6.3 MVA + 1*12.5 MVA66/11kV Power Transformers Marshalling box, Bucholtz relay, Thermomter, OLTC, RTCC upto control panel
Releasing of 11kV NCT mounting structure
Releasing of 11kV cable termination structure
Releasing of 11kV MCVCB Incomer switchgears panel

Power Transformers: 20MVA, -66/11kV TRANSFORMER.
a) 66/11KV, Delta/Star, Dyn11, 3-Ph, 50Hz, Core Type, 2 Winding Delta/Star transformer, vector group DYn11 with OLTC ONAN/ONAF with fan control cubicle, RTCC Panel, Numerical RTCC panel, first filling of Oil and 10% spare oil in non-returnable drums etc., complete with Terminal connectors suitable for Single Drake/Moose ACSR on primary side  of transformer and 2 nos of 50 x 10 mm copper flat for each phase from LV side of Transformer to cable at 11 kV cable terminating structure with suitable support insulator on LV side of Transformer and 2 Nos of 75mm X 6mm copper flats from neutral terminal to earthmat through NCT along with necessary support pin insulators.(45 MT)

11KV Switchgear : 
A) 11kV, 31.5 kA, Metal Clad VCB Switchgear (2000A for Incomer and 1600 A for feeders), outdoor type, each comprising of 2IC+1F+1BC+2adoptor panel (Remote Announciation cum Control panel)  with CTs & PTs  etc., complete  as per technical specification.
Note: 1. The Remote Announciation cum Control panel is Simplex type.
2. The Electronic Trivector meters with ABT features has to be provided.
3. The Switchgears Suitable for  20MVA, -66/11kV Transformers.
4. The Switchgear will be supplied by KPTCL and  the Bidder has to quote for complete scope of erection of Switchgear including moving the Switchgear from the point of unloading to the point of erection, erection of the complete Switchgear, wiring of Switchgear, testing &  commissioning etc., complete.

For Establishing SCADA Communication as per KPTCL Specification
(a) Configuration of RTU and Engineering along with validation of data at SLDC

Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depthnot exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps
and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth forreuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools,usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils upto 300 mm depth

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, form work, centering & scaffolding and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.   Mix 1:3:6 Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregate

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Foundation works. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticizers laid in finished layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials, quality confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  form work, centering & scaffolding  and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications.  
M25 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates - For foundation (3% cosidered for Form work)
Providing  supplying and laying modular brick  other incidental charges complete as per the direction of engineer incharge of work.

Steel Fabrication: Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification All other type of structures

Providing and fixing Structural Steel work riveted, bolted or welded in built up sections, trusses and framed work, including cutting, hoisting, fixing in position and applying a priming coat of approved steel primer all complete including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.
